relationships.subject: miR-34c
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-34c greatly ameliorates neuropathic pain by inhibiting NLRP3-mediated neuroinflammation and cell apoptosis

relationships.subject: lncRNA XIST
relationships.evidence_quote: XIST sponges miR-544 to activate STAT3

relationships.subject: miR-32-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: Histone methylation-mediated miR-32-5p down-regulation regulated trigeminal neuropathic pain by targeting Cav3.2 channels

relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Significant downregulation of METTL3 and m6A methylation was found both in spared nerve injury-induced neuropathic pain rats

key_findings: Review: ncRNAs (miRNAs, lncRNAs, circRNAs) and m6A writers/erasers/readers regulate glial activation and pain-related genes in neuropathic pain.
METTL3 and m6A are reduced after nerve injury and METTL3 may serve as a biomarker.
